fieldNotes.truckGate: Single shared access road winds up from Cornelia Highway (US-23) to the hilltop pad. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, guard booth, or checkpoint pinch-point visible along the access road or at the dock-yard entrance in z20-z21 satellite. Open driveway = no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure along the access road or at the building in any view.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single south-facing dock bank; web sources confirm 38 truck dock doors with a 90-foot-deep dock - matches the 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Web sources cite a 50+ trailer drop lot; in current (2026) imagery the SE area is graded but not yet fully paved/striped, with only modest trailer presence on the dock apron - classed 10-25 from what is visibly developed, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated trailer drop lot is being developed SE of the dock apron (graded pad in current imagery); web confirms a 50+ trailer drop lot.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep 90-foot dock apron plus the long winding access approach give ample queuing room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors on a single (south) building face; no separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits on a graded hilltop pad cut into wooded terrain, isolated from any town, with only Cornelia Highway nearby; clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is rural and wooded but sits directly on a major 4-lane highway (US-23) within the Atlanta-Gainesville corridor; cellular coverage likely adequate, marked false (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the graded pad perimeter (~312m x ~303m).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; facility is near the future Northeast Georgia Inland Port but not currently rail-served.
fieldNotes.facilityNote: New CJ Logistics America cold storage warehouse, opened Nov 2024; 270,000 sq ft, 30,000 racked pallet positions, 3 storage rooms (finished goods, bakery, proteins), Alta EXPERT refrigeration + QFM blast freezing, USDA export office on-site.
